# Subcanopy Guard

> Context-aware indirect prompt injection scanner for AI agent tool outputs.

## What it does

Detects prompt injection attacks buried inside tool output, retrieved
documents, and other untrusted content that AI agents process.

## Key facts

- AgentDojo v1: 86.5% caught at 5.2% false positives, 0.85 ms per scan
- PromptWall: 45.1% overall at 0% false positives
- Zero runtime dependencies, pure Python standard library
- Python 3.14+, AGPL-3.0 with commercial licensing available

## Install

pip install subcanopy-guard

## Repository

https://github.com/Vick606/subcanopy-guard
